messages:
elena: Design check: onboarding checklist card density seems high on mobile. Should we collapse sample project cards into a carousel on small screens?

tom: Carousel reduces vertical scroll but degrades discoverability. Maybe collapse to 1 prominent sample card + a "More samples" link that opens a full drawer.

ben: For mobile perf, loading multiple screenshot images is costly. Lazy-load screenshots and use 16:9 low-res placeholders.

zoe: Accessibility: carousels are tough for screen readers. If we implement, add a visible index (e.g., "1 of 3") and ensure swipe gestures are keyboard accessible with left/right buttons.

elena: Good call. Let's do 1 prominent card plus small pager dots + accessible left/right buttons. Drawer shows full list with aria-labels.

ops-bot: telemetry: track clicks on 'More samples' and whether users open drawer -> event onboarding.samples.drawer_open

tom: Copy tweak: main CTA currently "Try a sample project". For mobile maybe shorter: "Try sample". Agree?

ben: Shorter is better on small buttons. Use 'Try sample' on widths < 420px.

zoe: Also add accessible text for the screenshot: visually-hidden span with full description.

elena: Action items: Tom update responsive copy, Ben implement lazy loading + placeholders, Zoe implement a11y attributes and pager labels. I'll update the spec. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
